mo_ta: Tiệm nail, salon tóc. Nhấn chi tiết cận, trước/sau, độ bóng.

prompts.prompt: Macro slow orbit around a hand with freshly done {{kiểu móng}} nails, glossy gel reflecting soft ring light, tiny sparkles catching the light, hand turning gracefully, pastel background, beauty commercial look. Audio: soft sparkle chime.

Close-up of a nail technician carefully painting {{màu sơn}} gel polish with a fine brush, then curing under a UV lamp glow, clean salon table, satisfying precise detail, bright soft light. Audio: gentle brush strokes, soft pop music.

Slow motion of a woman turning her head so her freshly styled {{kiểu tóc}} hair flips and flows, shiny healthy strands catching a backlight, salon mirror bokeh behind, confident smile, hair commercial cinematography. Audio: whoosh, upbeat music hit.

Same woman, same framing: begins with messy dull hair looking unsure, a quick spin transition, then reveals glossy {{kiểu tóc}} hair and a big smile, consistent lighting and background. Audio: record-scratch then upbeat drop.
prompts.ghi_chu: Dùng khung đầu + khung cuối (ảnh trước và sau thật) để giữ đúng người.

prompts.prompt: Flat lay of six hands in a neat grid, each showing a different {{chủ đề}} nail design, coordinated pastel background, soft even light, trendy Pinterest aesthetic, no text.

Smooth gimbal shot gliding through {{tên tiệm}}, a chic salon with pink velvet chairs, gold mirrors, neon sign glow and shelves of polish bottles, customers relaxing, bright inviting atmosphere. Audio: upbeat chill pop.
